result.instructions: Tools for WeatherLink, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of my weather stations are online, and when did each last report?"; "What are the current temperature, humidity and wind at my farm station?"; "How much rain did station 12345 record yesterday?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes WeatherLink data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run weatherlink_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run weatherlink_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run weatherlink_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. weatherlink_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: weatherlink_list_stations
tools.title: List stations
tools.description: List the weather stations your API Key can access, with their metadata. Start here to find a station id. WeatherLink v2: GET /v2/stations (or /v2/stations/{station-ids}).

station_ids.description: Comma-separated station ids (integer or UUID), up to 100. Leave empty to list every station your API Key can access.

tools.name: weatherlink_list_nodes
tools.title: List nodes
tools.description: List the nodes your API Key can access, with their metadata. WeatherLink v2: GET /v2/nodes (or /v2/nodes/{node-ids}).

node_ids.description: Comma-separated node ids, up to 100. Leave empty to list every node.

tools.name: weatherlink_list_sensors
tools.title: List sensors
tools.description: List the sensors your API Key can access, with their metadata. WeatherLink v2: GET /v2/sensors (or /v2/sensors/{sensor-ids}).

sensor_ids.description: Comma-separated sensor ids, up to 100. Leave empty to list every sensor.

tools.name: weatherlink_get_sensor_activity
tools.title: Get sensor activity
tools.description: Get the last reporting time of sensors, to find sensors that stopped reporting. Leave sensor_ids empty for every sensor. WeatherLink v2: GET /v2/sensor-activity (or /v2/sensor-activity/{sensor-ids}).

sensor_ids.description: Comma-separated sensor ids, up to 100. Leave empty to list every sensor.

tools.name: weatherlink_get_current_conditions
tools.title: Get current conditions
tools.description: Get the latest weather observation for one station, per sensor (for example temperature, humidity, wind and rain). How recent the record is depends on the access level: Pro+ gives the most recent record, Pro the most recent 5-minute record. WeatherLink v2: GET /v2/current/{station-id}.

station_id.description: One station id (integer or UUID), from weatherlink_list_stations.

tools.name: weatherlink_get_historic_data
tools.title: Get historic data
tools.description: Get historic weather records for one station between two Unix times. The window can be at most 24 hours (86400 seconds). Each record's timestamp is the END of its recording interval. Access depends on the subscription level (Basic has no historic data). WeatherLink v2: GET /v2/historic/{station-id}.

station_id.description: One station id (integer or UUID), from weatherlink_list_stations.

start_timestamp.description: Start of the window (Unix seconds). Must be earlier than end_timestamp.

end_timestamp.description: End of the window (Unix seconds). At most 24 hours after start_timestamp.

tools.name: weatherlink_get_et_report
tools.title: Get evapotranspiration report
tools.description: Get the evapotranspiration (ET) data for one WeatherLink Live station. Only WeatherLink Live stations report ET. WeatherLink v2: GET /v2/report/et/{station-id}.

station_id.description: One station id (integer or UUID), from weatherlink_list_stations.
